title: Circuit satisfiability query
statement: Given a deterministic finite-state machine $M$ over the binary alphabet, a binary string $D$, a selector $	ext{sel}$, and binary strings $T$, $A$, and $x$, define the answer to be true exactly when the pair consisting of $D$ and the query formed from $	ext{sel}$, $T$, $A$, and $x$ belongs to the language of satisfiable fan-in-two circuits.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic finite-state machine M over Bool
